title: Decide: Mediation or Court?
description: Helps a co-parent work through whether to attempt mediation or pursue a court motion for a specific issue. Branches based on conflict type, child safety, and prior mediation history. **Educational decision support, not legal advice.**

jurisdictionTags.scopeNote: Missouri-specific mediation rules (RSMo 452.372) referenced in some branches.

steps.title: Safety screening
steps.content: Is there any current protective order, active DV concern, or child safety issue?

branches.label: Safety issue present — mediation not recommended

steps.title: Mediation is generally not appropriate
steps.content: When a protective order or active safety concern exists, mediation is generally not appropriate and may put you or your child at risk. Consult a licensed family-law attorney immediately and consider contacting a domestic violence advocate. This playbook will not guide you toward mediation in this situation.

steps.title: Prior mediation history
steps.content: Have you tried to resolve this through informal discussion or prior mediation?

steps.title: Generate recommendation
steps.content: Based on issue type and prior attempts, the assistant will generate a reasoned recommendation with the tradeoffs of each path. You make the final decision.

steps.title: Next steps document
steps.content: Produce a one-page summary with: recommended path, reasoning, preparation checklist, and questions for an attorney.

artifactTemplates.name: Mediation vs Court Decision Summary
